claim_text: This allows us to identify current or future hazards and reduce the potential and impact of future safety incidents before they occur.
metric_name: Lost time injury frequency rates (LTIFR); Total recordable injury frequency rate (TRIFR)
context_text:
[Table]PERFORMANCE IN FY25
Health & Safety Performance FY25 FY24
Lost time injury frequency rates (LTIFR) 3.03 0.00
Total recordable injury frequency rate (TRIFR) 11.12 9.24
label: Suspected Greenwash
rationale_short: Although PMHMP implementation and audit progress are evidenced, both LTIFR and TRIFR increased in FY25 compared to FY24, indicating no improvement in safety outcomes and contradicting the claim’s outcome-oriented statement.
llm_reason: The claim’s decisive assertion is that the company can identify current/future hazards and proactively reduce the potential and impact of future safety incidents before they occur (a preventive effectiveness/outcome claim). The only provided evidence is a set of injury frequency rate values (LTIFR/TRIFR: 3.03; 0.00; 11.12; 9.24) with no timeframe, scope, baseline, trend, or linkage to hazard-identification processes or to reductions in incident potential/impact. These rates do not substantiate that hazards are being identified in advance or that future incidents are being reduced before occurring, and they do not demonstrate any reduction (no before/after comparison).
